name: Palantir Technologies

eyebrow.en: Palantir Technologies Inc. · Class A common stock · Aventura, Florida
eyebrow.zh: Palantir Technologies · A 类普通股 · 佛罗里达州阿文图拉

title.en: Data and AI software for the Pentagon and corporate America, growing faster at $8B than at $2B.
title.zh: 服务五角大楼与美国企业的数据和 AI 软件，规模 80 亿时比 20 亿时增长更快。

lede.en: Palantir sells software (Foundry, Gotham and its AI Platform, AIP) that lets governments and companies run decisions on their own data. Revenue grew 96% last quarter to $2.31B, US commercial sales passed US government sales for the first time, and the full-year guide was raised to about $8.53B. The catch: new signings rose only 6%, and at $178 the stock is valued at about 50 times this year's revenue guide.
lede.zh: Palantir 销售让政府和企业基于自身数据做决策的软件（Foundry、Gotham 及 AI 平台 AIP）。上季营收增长 96% 至 23.1 亿美元，美国商业收入首次超过美国政府收入，全年指引上调至约 85.3 亿美元。问题在于：新签合同额仅增长 6%，且股价 $178 时市值约为今年营收指引的 50 倍。

s.zh: GAAP 历史市盈率约 126 倍 · 预期（FY27）约 77 倍

s.en: Q4 2026 · expected about Feb 1, after close · not yet confirmed
s.zh: 2026 第四季 · 预计约 2月1日盘后 · 公司尚未确认

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Palantir fell from $207 in November 2025 to $107 in late June, almost doubled to a record close of $209.05 on Oct 9, then slipped to $178.34 on Nov 2, the day of its Q3 report.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。Palantir 由 2025年11月的 $207 跌至 6月下旬的 $107，随后几乎翻倍，10月9日以 $209.05 创收盘纪录，11月2日（第三季财报当日）回落至 $178.34。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Palantir's fiscal year is the calendar year. GAAP operating margin swung from −14% in Q4 2021 to 47% as stock-based pay shrank relative to sales; Q4 2024 dips to 1% on a one-off stock compensation charge. The last bar is the midpoint of the Q4 2026 guide of $2.649–2.653B.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。Palantir 财年与日历年一致。随着股权激励相对营收缩小，GAAP 营业利润率由 2021 第四季的 −14% 升至 47%；2024 第四季因一次性股权激励费用降至 1%。最后一根柱为 2026 第四季指引 26.49–26.53 亿美元的中值。

s.zh: 调整后营业利润率 62% · GAAP 47%
同比 +79%，环比 +4% · 总剩余合同额 134 亿

p.en: US commercial revenue ($984M) passed US government ($953M) for the first time, and the full-year guide now calls for more than $3.559B, growth of at least 143%.
p.zh: 美国商业收入（9.84 亿美元）首次超过美国政府收入（9.53 亿），全年指引超过 35.59 亿美元，增长不低于 143%。

p.en: Q3 cash from operations was $1.20B, a 52% margin. Palantir holds $10.4B of cash and Treasuries and raised its adjusted free cash flow guide to $4.8–5.0B this year.
p.zh: Q3 经营现金流 12.0 亿美元，利润率 52%。持有 104 亿美元现金及国债，今年调整后自由现金流指引上调至 48–50 亿。

p.en: Total contract value rose only 6% to $2.92B (49% growth in Q2), and US commercial deal value grew 4% from June while revenue grew 29%. The CFO said new Sovereign AI deals ran shorter than usual.
p.zh: 总合同额仅增长 6% 至 29.2 亿美元（Q2 增长 49%），美国商业剩余合同额较 6 月仅增 4%，而营收环比增长 29%。CFO 表示新的主权 AI 合同期限短于以往。

p.en: The US is 84% of revenue. Sales outside the US, about $376M, grew about 26%, so growth depends heavily on one country's companies and agencies.
p.zh: 美国占营收 84%。美国以外营收约 3.76 亿美元，增长约 26%，增长高度依赖美国企业和机构。

p.en: At about $429B the stock trades near 50 times this year's revenue guide and about 126 times trailing GAAP earnings. Any slowdown would hit a price like that hard.
p.zh: 市值约 4,290 亿美元，约为今年营收指引的 50 倍、GAAP 历史盈利的约 126 倍。增长一旦放缓，股价将大受冲击。

p.en: Stock-based compensation was $319M in Q3 (14% of revenue). It is the main gap between the 62% adjusted and 47% GAAP operating margin, and diluted shares (2.57B) run well above basic (2.41B).
p.zh: Q3 股权激励 3.19 亿美元（占营收 14%），是调整后 62% 与 GAAP 47% 营业利润率之间的主要差距；稀释股数（25.7 亿）明显高于基本股数（24.1 亿）。

p.en: Adds detail the release leaves out, including buybacks, remaining performance obligations and customer concentration.
p.zh: 补充新闻稿未披露的细节，包括回购、剩余履约义务和客户集中度。

p.en: The stopgap bill funds federal agencies to Dec 11. A full-year defense budget, or another extension, shapes new government awards.
p.zh: 临时拨款法案为联邦机构提供资金至12月11日。全年国防预算或再次延期将影响新的政府合同。

h.zh: 2026 第四季财报（预计约 2月1日）

p.en: Guide is $2.649–2.653B revenue and $1.640–1.644B adjusted operating income, plus the first 2027 outlook.
p.zh: 指引营收 26.49–26.53 亿美元，调整后营业利润 16.40–16.44 亿，并将给出首份 2027 年展望。

Palantir 3Q profit soars as US commercial overtakes government (Dow Jones / Morningstar)
Palantir grows revenue 96% as new deals slow (Motley Fool)
Price, market cap and consensus estimates: FMP and Stock Analysis, as of Nov 2, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Nov 2, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Palantir Technologies Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年11月2日（2026 第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Palantir Technologies Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Palantir's fiscal year is the calendar year. This is GAAP free cash flow; Palantir's own 'adjusted' figure also adds back employer taxes on stock pay. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 第四季至 2026 第三季共 20 个季度。Palantir 财年与日历年一致。此处为 GAAP 自由现金流；公司自报的“调整后”数字另加回股权激励相关的雇主税费。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.en: Sep 30, 2026 · cash, equivalents and US Treasuries
s.zh: 2026年9月30日 · 现金、等价物及美国国债

read.en: Palantir spends almost nothing on equipment (capex was $8M in Q3), so free cash flow tracks operating cash flow. It rose from under $100M a quarter in 2021–22 to $1.2B in each of Q2 and Q3 2026, and the last four quarters add up to about $4.1B. One caveat: stock-based pay ($319M in Q3) is a real cost to shareholders that never shows up as cash out, so free cash flow flatters the picture; after subtracting it, Q3 was still about $880M.
read.zh: Palantir 几乎不需设备投资（Q3 资本开支仅 800 万美元），自由现金流基本等于经营现金流。季度自由现金流由 2021–22 年不足 1 亿美元升至 2026 年 Q2、Q3 各约 12 亿，近四季合计约 41 亿。需注意：股权激励（Q3 为 3.19 亿）是股东承担的真实成本，却不体现为现金流出，因此自由现金流显得更好看；扣除后 Q3 仍约 8.8 亿。

read.en: My base case uses the raised $4.8–5.0B full-year adjusted free cash flow guide. GAAP free cash flow was about $3.3B in the first nine months, which leaves roughly $1.5–1.7B for Q4; I use about $1.6B, then let growth continue into 2027. That gives about $6.6B over four quarters. Collections are lumpy and Q3 was flat on Q2 despite 20% revenue growth, so single quarters can miss.
read.zh: 我的基准情景采用上调后的 48–50 亿美元全年调整后自由现金流指引。前九个月 GAAP 自由现金流约 33 亿，Q4 约需 15–17 亿，我取约 16 亿，并让增长延续至 2027 年，四季合计约 66 亿。回款有波动：Q3 营收环比增长 20%，自由现金流却与 Q2 持平，单季可能不及预期。

p.en: Operating expenses rose 46% to $845M in Q3 as headcount and marketing spending grew.
p.zh: Q3 营业费用增长 46% 至 8.45 亿美元，主要来自人员和营销支出增加。

p.en: Small: $19M in each of Q3 and Q4 2025 and none in the first half of 2026; the Q3 figure comes with the 10-Q. They do not offset stock-pay dilution.
p.zh: 规模很小：2025 年 Q3、Q4 各 1,900 万美元，2026 上半年为零；Q3 数字将随 10-Q 披露。不足以抵消股权激励稀释。

p.en: Only $7–15M a quarter ($8M in Q3); customers mostly run Palantir on cloud capacity they pay for.
p.zh: 每季仅 700 万至 1,500 万美元（Q3 为 800 万）；客户大多在自己付费的云上运行 Palantir。

p.en: $6.52B of US commercial deal value still to run, up 79%, though only 4% above June.
p.zh: 美国商业剩余合同额 65.2 亿美元，增长 79%，但较 6 月仅增 4%。

p.en: A 62% adjusted operating margin means most new revenue turns into cash.
p.zh: 调整后营业利润率 62%，新增营收大多转化为现金。

p.en: The $10.4B cash pile earned $89M of interest in Q3.
p.zh: 104 亿美元现金在 Q3 赚取 8,900 万利息。

bridgeNote.en: Palantir pays no dividend and buys back little stock, so cash keeps piling up. The real cost to owners is dilution from stock pay, not cash going out.
bridgeNote.zh: Palantir 不派息、回购很少，因此现金持续累积。股东的真正成本是股权激励带来的稀释，而非现金流出。
